about_the_game:
Cards command the Three Kingdoms, conquer the world! Three Kingdoms: The Records Reborn – Collect legendary generals, build mighty formations, strategize your way to victory, and claim the Central Plains!

Game Features

  • Strategic Depth, Decisive Victory: Engage in profound tactical card duels. Meticulously craft your unique deck and outsmart your opponents to achieve high scores!

  • A Hundred Heroes, Unique Abilities: Discover 100 intricately designed cards, each embodying the distinctive charm and historical prowess of Three Kingdoms heroes with varied abilities!

  • Leverage Heaven & Earth, Conquer All: Master 6 unique "Heavenly Blessings" (Timings) and 6 "Earthly Advantages" (Terrain) elements. Seize the opportune moment and capitalize on the landscape to dominate the battlefield!

  • Civil & Military Prowess, Paths to Glory: Whether through shrewd governance or decisive military campaigns, accumulate victory points via diverse strategic paths, embracing both "Civil Administration" and "Martial Exploits"!

  • Solo & Duo, Endless Fun: Immerse yourself in captivating single-player challenges, or engage in thrilling head-to-head battles with a friend in two-player mode!
